$comment: ONE cron entry, ONE execution per day — Vercel's Hobby plan allows no more.
03:30 UTC = 09:00 Asia/Kolkata. India is UTC+05:30 and has never observed
daylight saving, so this lands on 09:00 IST every day of the year with no
?openai=daily is what makes this the ONLY trigger for the OpenAI project
checks. The same route is called every 5 minutes by
.github/workflows/monitor-cron.yml for VM/app monitoring, and without the
flag that poll would become the de-facto trigger — each OpenAI check is a
real billable request. The workflow calls the bare path and does no OpenAI
work; only this entry carries the flag.
